newsitem.title: USA: Smith Corona terminates stock sale pact.
newsitem.headline: Smith Corona terminates stock sale pact.

text.p: Smith Corona Corp said on Tuesday it has terminated its agreement for MaraFund Ltd to acquire 15 percent of the new common stock in the reorganized Smith Corona.
Smith Corona claims that MaraFund did not meet its contractual obligations, but the termination of the deal does not alter the company's plan of reorganization it filed with Bankruptcy Court.
Smith Corona, which had filed Chapter 11 in July 1995, had received Bankruptcy Court approval to extend the schedule for voting and confirming the reorganization, it said.
MaraFund was not immediately available for comment.
